definitions.explanation: The act of confining or imprisoning someone in a room or space against their will. Used both in legal contexts and in general descriptions of captivity.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{被害者|ひがいしゃ}を{監禁|かんきん}した。
{彼|かれ}は{三日間|みっかかん}{部屋|へや}に{監禁|かんきん}されていた。
examples.english: He was confined in a room for three days.

examples.japanese: {不法|ふほう}{監禁|かんきん}の{容疑|ようぎ}で{男|おとこ}が{逮捕|たいほ}されたと{報道|ほうどう}された。
examples.english: It was reported that a man was arrested on suspicion of unlawful confinement.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb ({監禁|かんきん}する) or in the passive ({監禁|かんきん}される). Common in news reports about criminal cases. In legal terminology, {監禁|かんきん}{罪|ざい} refers to the crime of unlawful confinement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不法|ふほう}{監禁|かんきん}: unlawful confinement
- {監禁|かんきん}{罪|ざい}: crime of confinement
- {監禁|かんきん}{状態|じょうたい}: state of captivity
- {監禁|かんきん}される: to be confined

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {拘束|こうそく}: restraint, detention (broader; includes physical restraint)
- {幽閉|ゆうへい}: imprisonment, confinement (literary; often used for historical contexts)
